messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Perform a digital microfluidic human plasma protein depletion assay using Protein A/G and Anti-HSA magnetic beads. First, mix Protein A/G beads and Anti-HSA beads, then combine with the protein sample and incubate at 25C for 10 minutes. Detect the signal; if it exceeds 5, perform a secondary depletion cycle with fresh beads, incubate at 25C for 10 minutes, detect the new signal, and dispose of the first depletion mixture.

module fluorescence

manifest ProteinSample
manifest ProteinAGBeads
manifest AntiHSABeads
manifest WorkingBuffer

instructions:

beadsAG = dispense 4 units of ProteinAGBeads
beadsHSA = dispense 4 units of AntiHSABeads
beads = mix beadsAG with beadsHSA

sample = dispense 4 units of ProteinSample

depletion1 = mix beads with sample
heat depletion1 at 25c for 10m

signal1 = detect fluorescence on depletion1 for 30s

if (signal1 > 5) {
    beadsAG2 = dispense 4 units of ProteinAGBeads
    beadsHSA2 = dispense 4 units of AntiHSABeads
    beads2 = mix beadsAG2 with beadsHSA2

    depletion2 = mix beads2 with depletion1
    heat depletion2 at 25c for 10m

    signal2 = detect fluorescence on depletion2 for 30s
    dispose depletion1
}
